SUBSCRIBE for free training, inspiration and resources for bodywork and massage therapists -- to turn your passion into a rocking business!

We love helping therapists have a maintainable practice through our online training programs in Myofunctional Manual Lymphatic Drainage. 

Karen Robertson is an international trainer in Myofunctional Manual Lymphatic Drainage for bodywork and massage therapists. While being a successful clinic owner of 20 years, Karen understands what it takes to run a rock solid practice and achieve an abundant maintainable practice for a long successful career.
